Archival Dispatch: 23 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Dick Orkin's Chickenman, A Cavalcade of Kings, and Smilin' Ed's Aladdin's Lamp

Batch 55 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 55 resolves 23 historical radio broadcasts spanning 1960s satirical pop serials, 1930s royal biographical docudramas, and early 1930s acoustic variety programming: 7 classic episodes from Dick Orkin's celebrated Chicago comedy superhero satire Chickenman ("The Wonderful White-Winged Weekend Warrior", 1966), 8 episodes from the 1938 British historical dramatization series A Cavalcade of Kings (covering the reigns of William the Conqueror, Edward III, Richard II, Richard III, Henry IV, Elizabeth I, Charles II, and James II), and 8 vintage 1932 musical variety shows from Smilin' Ed McConnell's Aladdin's Lamp.

1. Chickenman — 1966 WCFL Chicago Radio Satire

Created by Dick Orkin, starring Jim Runyon, Jane Roberts, and Dick Orkin:

Chickenman_Will_Chickenman_Fly_2.mp3 "Chickenman: Will Chickenman Fly? (Part 2)" 1966-08-04 The feathered crusader rides the city bus with disastrous results.
